requirements.requirement: Nginx on node1, node2, and node3 serves the corresponding node identifier from / on port 5660.
requirements.summary: Direct HTTP probes returned node1, node2, and node3 respectively, with Nginx observed listening on port 5660 on every backend. Final checks also showed each service active, enabled, and configuration-valid.

requirements.requirement: HAProxy on node4 serves HTTP on port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends.
requirements.summary: HAProxy was active and listening on port 80. Six consecutive requests returned node1, node2, and node3 twice in round-robin order; the final validated configuration includes all three health-checked backends.

requirements.requirement: The HTTP service remains available during the failure of any single backend and returns to full operation after recovery.
requirements.summary: A healthy three-backend baseline was observed. Node2 was then stopped and directly confirmed unreachable; after HAProxy's health-check interval, eight requests all succeeded through node1 and node3. Node2 was restored, and subsequent requests again reached all three backends.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied by direct observations: each Nginx backend serves its identifier, HAProxy load-balances on port 80, and a complete baseline-disruption-restoration-recovery transition demonstrated continued availability during a backend outage. Only minor temporary-file residue affects hygiene.
limitations: The bounded failure transition directly exercised node2 only; equivalent node1 and node3 outages were not separately induced. Their identical HAProxy health-check configuration supports, but does not behaviorally prove, those two variants.
No reboot was performed, although all relevant services were directly observed enabled and active; reboot persistence was not an explicit task requirement.

operational_hygiene.summary: Final snapshots show no failed services or package-manager inconsistency, and the added listeners are required by the task. A minor deduction applies because executor-created installation log and result files remained under /tmp on all four nodes.
